name: energy_burning_boost_at_top_speed_costs_the_fuel
description: The car already runs at 2300 uu/s (the speed cap) with a full tank and holds throttle + boost for 30 steps along the clear lane x = 480: it burns 33.3 boost/s * 2 s = 66.7 boost (100 -> 33.3) and gains no speed. Hand calc: Phi falls from 1.0 + 1.0 = 2.0 to 1.0 + 0.537 = 1.537; sum = gamma * 1.537 - 2.0 + (gamma - 1) * sum of the 29 middle Phi values (about 51) = -0.468 - 0.159 = -0.627. Boost spent without gaining energy is a pure loss (the fuel price).

expect.intent: fuel burned with no speed to gain is paid as a loss of about -0.63 (-47 at weight 75)
